missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Ракета' is a feminine noun in the nominative, the subject of 'стоит'. 'Большая' is the agreeing feminine adjective and 'на старте' gives the location.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Ракету' is the accusative direct object of 'построили'. 'Новую' is the agreeing feminine accusative adjective. 'Инженеры' is the nominative plural subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Ракеты' is the genitive form in the frame 'у этой ракеты' showing what the rocket has. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative after 'к'. 'К ракете' uses the dative form 'ракете' to show the fuel prepared for the rocket. 'Топливо' is the accusative object of 'готовят'.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after 'управлять'. 'Ракетой' is the instrumental form governed by 'управляет'. 'Огромной' agrees in the feminine instrumental describing the rocket.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'На ракете' uses the prepositional form 'ракете' after 'на' to show where they travel. 'Два космонавта' is the numeral phrase subject.
Strategic focus: Accusative after 'на'. 'Ракету' is the accusative governed by 'на' showing what they watch. 'Летящую' is the agreeing feminine accusative participle.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after numeral. After 'две' the noun takes the genitive singular 'ракеты'. 'На космодроме' is the prepositional location of the two rockets.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after 'несколько'. 'Ракет' is the genitive plural required by 'несколько'. 'Страна' is the nominative subject of 'запустила'.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Ракета' is the nominative subject of 'поднялась', which agrees in the feminine. 'В небо' uses the accusative to mark the direction of ascent.
